title: ClickHouse + Kafka

project.name: Real-time Analytics Platform
project.prd: Ingest events via Kafka, store in ClickHouse, and serve real-time aggregations through an API.
project.architecture: FastAPI producers → Kafka → consumer → ClickHouse → analytics API and dashboards.
